title: I wanted to give you a quick...
content_text: I wanted to give you a quick update on the Q3 marketing campaign. We are currently on track with the timeline, and the creative assets are almost finalized. However, we have hit a slight delay on the vendor side regarding the video production. I am pushing them to deliver by end of this week, but we might need to adjust the launch date if they cannot meet the deadline. I will keep you posted as soon as I hear back from them.
